providers.name: PSIP

pricing.plansText: Essential: £199/month or £169/month billed annually. Growth: £599/month or £499/month billed annually. Professional: £1,199/month or £992/month billed annually. Bid Agency and Enterprise: custom pricing.
pricing.seatDetail: Bid Agency and Enterprise advertise unlimited users and team or multi-client workspaces. Included users and additional-seat pricing for Essential, Growth and Professional are not publicly stated.
pricing.trialDetail: 14-day Growth-plan trial; no credit card required. The pricing table does not list a trial for Essential or Professional.

comparablePlans.notes: Annual total is calculated as the explicitly published £169/month billed annually rate multiplied by 12. Prices exclude VAT.
Annual total is calculated as the explicitly published £499/month billed annually rate multiplied by 12. Prices exclude VAT. Includes the 14-day no-card trial.
Annual total is calculated as the explicitly published £992/month billed annually rate multiplied by 12. Prices exclude VAT.
Custom tailored pricing; multiple client workspaces and team management are listed. Billing period, currency and pricing basis are not published.
Custom tailored pricing. Billing period, currency and pricing basis are not published.

keywordAlerts.detail: Saved alerts accept keywords and CPV codes, with optional buyer, value, portal and geography filters. Frequency is daily on Essential, every four hours on Growth and hourly on Professional.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Every plan includes explainable 1-10 AI relevance scoring against a business profile; the provider says it matches capabilities even when a buyer uses different terminology.

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer profiles aggregate spend, suppliers, incumbent payments, procurement history and renewals across records. PSIP documents source-ID deduplication, buyer enrichment using NHS ODS and GIAS identifiers, and a validated ingestion pipeline. Depth is plan-dependent.

evidence.label: PSIP data coverage and identity handling

supplierProfiles.detail: Growth and higher plans provide competitor and supplier tracking. Users can search a supplier to see award history and, where covered, payments across buyers; the feature is not included on Essential.

renewalSignals.detail: The Contract Expiry Tracker surfaces published contract end dates in 30, 90, 180 and 365-day windows with buyer, incumbent and value; it is listed on every standard plan.

similarContracts.detail: The reviewed pages establish award history and incumbent context but do not state that comparable historical contracts are automatically surfaced against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages mention tender documents and official spend publications, but not buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored documents beyond procurement records.

buyerRequirements.detail: Growth and higher plans extract mandatory requirements into a compliance checklist and structure drafting against tender requirements and evaluation criteria; this is not included on Essential.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Growth and higher plans provide a bid/no-bid scorecard, compliance checklist, strengths and red flags, clarification questions, missing-evidence placeholders and a staged bid pipeline. Essential does not include this workflow.

awardHistory.detail: Supplier searches show public-sector award history including buyers, values, dates, durations and categories. Standard-plan data history is six months on Essential, twelve months on Growth and full on Professional.

frameworks.detail: All standard plans list Crown Commercial Service and Scottish framework tracking. The framework tool covers framework names, references, lots, expiry dates, competition windows and call-off monitoring.

competitorTracking.detail: Growth and higher plans track named suppliers, their wins and approaching expiries and can alert on those events; Essential excludes competitor and supplier tracking.

exportsApi.detail: Growth includes CSV export. Professional adds API export, CRM integrations for Salesforce and HubSpot, and Zapier or Make delivery; Essential has none of these listed.

collaboration.detail: Bid Agency and Enterprise include unlimited users, team management and team or multi-client workspaces. Standard-plan user counts and shared-workspace access are not publicly stated.

bidWriting.detail: Growth and higher plans include evidence-gated drafting for executive summaries, method statements, win themes, compliance checklists and clarification questions. Essential excludes the bid workspace and drafting.

explicitPortals.detail: Named as one of the five official UK procurement portals searched by every PSIP alert.
Named as one of the five official UK procurement portals searched by every PSIP alert.
Named as PCS Scotland on the tender-alert page and as Public Contracts Scotland in the FAQ.
Named as one of the five official UK procurement portals searched by every PSIP alert.
Named as one of the five official UK procurement portals searched by every PSIP alert.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: PSIP says tender data is sourced from the five named official UK government procurement APIs and portals and updated daily.
The pricing table lists Procurement Act pipeline notices on all three standard plans.

caveats: All feature, coverage, corpus-size, scoring and latency statements are provider claims and were not independently tested by Civensa.
Buyer spend coverage is narrower than tender coverage: PSIP publishes a changing list of covered public bodies and says deeper buyer intelligence is plan-dependent.
Award and spend intelligence depends on what official buyers publish; the provider advises source traceability but underlying records can still be incomplete.
The standard-plan pages do not state included user counts or additional-seat prices. Unlimited users are stated only for Bid Agency and Enterprise.
AI and generated bid material still require human verification against the original notice and the supplier's evidence.

providers.name: Scrymint

pricing.plansText: Free: £0 forever. Pro: £49/month, billed monthly and cancel anytime. Intelligence: £149/month.
pricing.seatDetail: Included users and additional-seat pricing are not publicly stated on the reviewed pages.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing page.
pricing.trialDetail: No paid-plan trial is stated. Users start on the permanent free plan and may upgrade later.

comparablePlans.notes: Advertised as £0 forever. No annual billing option, VAT treatment or user allowance is published.
Billed monthly and cancel anytime. No annual billing option, VAT treatment or user allowance is published.
Only a monthly headline price is published; billing commitment, VAT treatment and user allowance are not stated.

keywordAlerts.detail: Free includes one daily email alert. Pro adds unlimited alerts and saved searches; Scrymint describes niche or trade-based matching and filters beyond keywords.

semanticAiMatching.detail: The reviewed pages advertise filters and AI bid/no-bid scoring, but do not establish semantic or AI relevance matching for tender discovery or alerts.

buyerProfiles.detail: Public buyer entities aggregate live tenders, awards and tracked value across notices, while Pro adds spend history. The documented API describes buyers as entity-resolved and exposes a buyer's spend, top suppliers and recent notices.

supplierProfiles.detail: Public supplier entities aggregate awards, buyers, values and renewal context across notices. The API describes the platform data as entity-resolved and exposes each supplier's awards and buyer relationships.

renewalSignals.detail: Pro includes contract expiry and renewal signals. The public supplier directory also describes finding where supplier contracts are up for renewal.

similarContracts.detail: Searchable historical awards are established, but the reviewed pages do not say that comparable past contracts are automatically surfaced against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish access to buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored documents beyond notices and awards.

buyerRequirements.detail: The reviewed pages do not state that requirements, certifications, policies or evaluation criteria are extracted into a structured view.

requirementsPlanning.detail: AI bid/no-bid scoring is advertised, but the reviewed pages do not establish a gap, evidence or readiness-planning workflow.

awardHistory.detail: All plans can search tenders and awards and see who won past contracts. Buyer and supplier pages expose historical winners, buyers and tracked values.

frameworks.detail: Forward pipeline notices are stated, but a framework, DPS, dynamic-market or route-to-market discovery feature is not established on the reviewed product pages.

competitorTracking.detail: The Intelligence plan includes competitor and incumbent tracking. Public supplier profiles provide incumbent research, but named monitoring behavior is not described in detail.

exportsApi.detail: Pro includes CSV export. Scrymint also documents a JSON API for tenders, awards, buyers, suppliers and trends, with a stated free allowance of 1,000 requests per day.

collaboration.detail: The reviewed pages do not state multiple users, assignments, comments, a shared team pipeline or another collaboration workflow.

bidWriting.detail: The Intelligence plan advertises AI-drafted first-pass responses. Scrymint separately offers introductions to vetted bid writers; scope and usage limits are not publicly detailed.

explicitPortals.detail: Named as a daily official open-data feed.
Named as a daily official open-data feed.
Named as one of the devolved procurement portals ingested daily.
Named as one of the devolved procurement portals ingested daily.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: Scrymint says it searches every UK government tender and award and uses official open-data feeds updated daily.
Scrymint says Procurement Act 2023 forward pipeline notices expose planned contracts up to 18 months ahead.

caveats: All feature, coverage, corpus-size, scoring and pricing statements are provider claims and were not independently tested by Civensa.

The dedicated data-source page explicitly names Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and Sell2Wales but does not name eTendersNI; broad 'every UK feed' wording is therefore not recorded as explicit Northern Ireland portal coverage.
Pricing does not state VAT treatment, included users, additional-seat pricing or a paid trial.
AI bid/no-bid scoring, drafting, competitor tracking and pipeline forecasts are restricted to the £149/month Intelligence plan.
API commercial licensing and bulk-feed terms require contact despite the advertised free request allowance.

providers.name: Supply2Gov

pricing.plansText: Free Local Area: £0. Country: from £25/month, £140 per six months or £270/year. UK Wide: from £80/month, £455 per six months or £799/year. UK and Ireland: from £95/month, £540 per six months or £899/year.
pricing.seatDetail: Included users and additional-seat pricing are not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing and FAQ pages.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing page.
pricing.trialDetail: No time-limited trial is stated. A permanent free Local Area plan is advertised and can be upgraded.

comparablePlans.notes: Permanent free access to one chosen local area. No annual billing option, VAT treatment or user allowance is published.
Prices are advertised as 'from'. A six-month price from £140 is also published but is not a schema billing field. VAT and user allowance are not stated.
Prices are advertised as 'from'. A six-month price from £455 is also published but is not a schema billing field. VAT and user allowance are not stated.
Prices are advertised as 'from'. A six-month price from £540 is also published but is not a schema billing field. VAT and user allowance are not stated.

keywordAlerts.detail: Daily Email Alert profiles use keywords or phrases and CPV codes. Provider guidance also describes region, buyer type, value, category and exclusion filters; alerts are sent on working days.

semanticAiMatching.detail: The reviewed pages establish keyword, phrase, category and CPV matching but do not establish semantic, machine-learning or AI relevance matching.

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer-type filters and buyer names are discussed, but the reviewed Supply2Gov pages do not establish structured buyer profiles or buyer intelligence pages.

supplierProfiles.detail: A user's own alert profile is documented, but structured profiles for winning or incumbent suppliers are not established for Supply2Gov.

renewalSignals.detail: Provider editorial guidance recommends studying cycles and pipeline notices, but the reviewed pages do not establish a Supply2Gov expiry, extension or re-tender monitoring feature.

similarContracts.detail: Past awards can be searched, but the reviewed pages do not say that similar historical contracts are automatically surfaced against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored document intelligence beyond procurement notices.

buyerRequirements.detail: The reviewed pages discuss common certifications and evaluation criteria as general guidance but do not establish structured extraction of buyer requirements inside Supply2Gov.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Plans include a Tender Ready Toolkit and general guides intended to help SMEs become ready to tender, but no per-opportunity requirements gap or evidence-planning workflow is established.

awardHistory.detail: Supply2Gov says its database publishes UK and Ireland contract and award notices; provider guidance describes searching past awards to identify winners, lots and indicative values.

frameworks.detail: Provider guidance describes framework, DPS and call-off notices and buyer, lot and keyword alerts for them, but a dedicated framework intelligence or route-to-market module is not established.

competitorTracking.detail: Past award research is described, but named competitor or incumbent monitoring is not established for Supply2Gov. The FAQ directs broader competitor intelligence to the separate Tracker service.

exportsApi.detail: The reviewed pages do not document CSV or Excel export, an API, webhooks, CRM integrations or another data export for Supply2Gov.

collaboration.detail: Opportunity tracking is described, but multiple users, assignments, comments or a shared team pipeline are not established on the reviewed Supply2Gov pages.

bidWriting.detail: Supply2Gov provides tendering guidance and a Tender Ready Toolkit, but the reviewed pages do not establish drafting software, an answer library, document analysis or managed writing as part of the product.

explicitPortals.detail: Every published Supply2Gov plan says it includes access to CompeteFor supply-chain opportunities.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: Supply2Gov says it monitors more than 3,000 public sources across the UK and Ireland, including high-value and local notices.
The UK Wide plan claims access to over 90% of UK and Republic of Ireland contracts and more than 200% more notices than national government portals.
Coverage is sold geographically: one free local area, one paid country, UK Wide, or UK and Republic of Ireland.

caveats: All feature, source-count and coverage statements are provider claims and were not independently tested by Civensa.
Paid prices are displayed as 'from'; VAT, included users and additional-seat prices are not stated on the reviewed pricing page.
The checked product pages explicitly name CompeteFor but do not publish a complete portal-by-portal source list for the claimed 3,000-plus sources.
Alerts are stated as available each working day, excluding UK bank holidays, rather than continuously.
Geographic access is plan-dependent; the free tier covers one chosen local area rather than nationwide records.
The provider points customers who need deeper buyer, competitor and spend intelligence to its separate Tracker product; those Tracker features are not attributed to Supply2Gov here.

providers.name: Tendarix

pricing.plansText: Tendarix Member: free. The provider says the service is free for everyone, with no card and no trial.
pricing.seatDetail: Team and multi-profile features are advertised, but user limits and any future additional-seat pricing are not publicly stated.
pricing.vatDetail: Not applicable to the currently advertised free service; future VAT treatment is not stated.
pricing.trialDetail: No trial: the provider says the current service is free and requires no payment card.

comparablePlans.notes: Currently advertised as free for everyone with no card and no trial. The terms permit features to change; no annual schedule, paid pricing basis or user limit is published.

keywordAlerts.detail: Tendarix advertises hybrid keyword and semantic search, unlimited saved alerts, and email and Slack delivery.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Each tender is scored against a company profile, geography, capacity and past performance using advertised hybrid keyword and semantic matching.

buyerProfiles.detail: A buyer page is said to aggregate award history, top suppliers, average deal size, SME share and renewal timing across notices, but the reviewed pages do not establish canonicalisation, deduplication or entity-resolution investment for buyer identities.

supplierProfiles.detail: Buyer profiles show top suppliers and competitor tracking is advertised, but structured standalone supplier, incumbent or winner profiles are not established on the reviewed public pages.

renewalSignals.detail: Renewal Radar is advertised on buyer profiles and is said to flag likely rebid windows six to nine months before a subsequent notice.

similarContracts.detail: Past performance influences matching and buyer award histories are available, but the reviewed pages do not say that comparable historical contracts are surfaced against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored document intelligence beyond procurement notices.

buyerRequirements.detail: A limited free tender summariser advertises an eligibility checklist, key dates, complexity rating and bid/no-bid score from a supplied tender URL; platform-wide structured requirements coverage is not described.

requirementsPlanning.detail: The eligibility checklist, bid/no-bid score and pipeline support basic qualification and preparation, but no full requirements-gap or evidence-planning workflow is documented.

awardHistory.detail: Buyer profiles include award history and suppliers; the service also advertises buyer award history for renewal research.

frameworks.detail: Tendarix says it watches framework call-offs, but the reviewed pages do not document a dedicated framework, DPS or dynamic-market intelligence module.

competitorTracking.detail: Competitor tracking is listed in the free plan, alongside buyer top-supplier and award-history data.

exportsApi.detail: The free plan lists CSV export and API access; consultancy workspaces also advertise webhooks and an API.

collaboration.detail: The service advertises saved searches per client, shared comments, a pipeline board, assignments, multi-profile workspaces and Slack alerts.

bidWriting.detail: The free plan advertises unlimited bid drafts and AI summaries and bid scoring.

explicitPortals.detail: Named as a national feed pulled directly into Tendarix.
Named as a national feed pulled directly into Tendarix.
Named as a national feed pulled directly into Tendarix.
Named as a national feed pulled directly into Tendarix.
Named as a national feed pulled directly into Tendarix.
Named as the EU-wide notice feed pulled into Tendarix.
The coverage page identifies In-tend as the portal vendor for 18 listed council sources.
The coverage page identifies ProContract as the portal vendor for eight listed council sources.
The coverage page identifies Bravo as the portal vendor for twelve listed council sources.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The homepage claims six national feeds plus more than 400 buyer portals, updated every 12 hours.
The live coverage page names 394 councils across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland and identifies each listed council's portal vendor and refresh status.

The coverage page explicitly links named local systems including London Tenders Portal, NEPO North East Procurement Organisation, Supply Hertfordshire, SE Shared Services eSourcing Portal and the Coventry, Solihull and Warwickshire Joint eTendering System.

caveats: All features, source counts, matching results, latency and coverage statements are provider claims and were not independently tested by Civensa.

The provider's live coverage page materially qualifies the '400+ buyer portals' headline: at research time it reported 394 councils tracked but only 31 active, with many displayed rows marked Broken or Pending.
The coverage page reported only four contracts indexed and 52 successful scrapes in the preceding 30 days at research time; this live status can change and should be rechecked before publication.
The homepage uses both 'updated every 12 hours' and 'every hour' language; the actual refresh cadence by source is not independently established.
The service is currently free, but its terms allow features to be added, changed or removed. No paid service level or future commercial model is published.
The terms say underlying notice details may be incomplete, outdated or erroneous and direct users to verify every opportunity against its official source.
User and fair-use limits for the advertised unlimited drafts, API, team workspaces and alerts are not publicly detailed.

providers.name: Tender Alerts UK

pricing.plansText: Monthly: £109/month. Yearly: £1,099/year. Both advertise full access to all features.
pricing.seatDetail: One user only. The provider says multiple-user functionality is not currently supported.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed page.
pricing.trialDetail: Seven-day trial for new customers. The provider says it converts to a charge after the trial unless cancelled; card requirement is not explicitly stated.

comparablePlans.notes: Monthly and yearly billing are published for the same full-access feature set. The seven-day new-customer trial converts to paid unless cancelled. VAT treatment is not stated.

evidence.label: Tender Alerts UK home and pricing

keywordAlerts.detail: A saved free-text search automatically creates an email alert sent Monday to Friday. Search can use title and description text plus region, deadline, category, source, framework and lot filters; up to 50 alerts are supported.

semanticAiMatching.detail: The reviewed page documents free-text and structured filters but does not establish semantic, machine-learning or AI relevance matching.

buyerProfiles.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish structured buyer profiles or buyer intelligence.

supplierProfiles.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish structured supplier, incumbent, winner or competitor profiles.

renewalSignals.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish contract-expiry, extension, renewal or re-tender monitoring.

similarContracts.detail: The reviewed pages do not state that comparable historical opportunities or awards are surfaced against a notice or profile.

buyerDocuments.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored documents beyond procurement notices.

buyerRequirements.detail: The reviewed pages do not state that participation conditions, certifications, policies or evaluation criteria are extracted into a structured view.

requirementsPlanning.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish gap planning, readiness actions, evidence planning or a requirements-preparation workflow.

awardHistory.detail: The reviewed pages describe tender opportunities but do not establish historical award search, winners, values or award profiles.

frameworks.detail: Framework is listed only as a raw search filter. The reviewed pages do not establish framework, DPS, dynamic-market or route-to-market discovery or intelligence.

competitorTracking.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish named competitor, incumbent, supplier or winner monitoring.

exportsApi.detail: The reviewed pages do not document CSV or Excel export, an API, webhooks, CRM integrations or another data export.

collaboration.detail: The provider explicitly says only one user is supported and that multiple-user functionality may be added in future.

bidWriting.detail: The reviewed pages do not establish drafting, an answer library, document analysis, a compliance matrix or managed bid-writing support.

eTendersNI is not named on the reviewed source list, so Northern Ireland national-portal coverage is not established.
